title.narrative: Emergency School Construction and Rehabilitation Project

description.narrative: The revised objective of the project is to improve conditions of learning of students in primary and scondary schools in Iraq through the construction of new schools, the extension of existing schools, and the rehabilitation of schools in need of urgent repair.

comment.narrative: There have been delays in completing 3 six-class blocks due to legal issue between contractor and MOHESR (including one plannedblock beyond the end of project target). Now that this issue is resolved, the remaining blocks are at 85 percent average physicalprogress, and will be completed under TEEP.
